answer: Each epoch, agents must answer a challenge word drawn from an on-chain randomness beacon, unknown until the epoch opens. An identity is honored only if its agent returns a task-specific, context-sensitive reply seeded by that word within the window. Templates cannot be precomputed since the beacon value arrives after registration, so a sybil attacker must run a full reasoning agent for every fake identity, live, every epoch.
